questions.question:
Seven people, S, T, U, V, W, X and Y are sitting in a straight line, facing north. Only two people sit to the right of W. Only three people sit between S and W. U is the immediate neighbour of T and X. X is not the immediate neighbour of W. V sits third to the right of T.

Who is sitting between W and V?
questions.solution:

1) Only two people sit to the right of W.

questions.question: If 6 July 2011 is a Wednesday, then what was the day of the week on 16 February 2010?
questions.solution:
Given: **6 July 2011** was Wednesday.

Now,

2011 to 2010 = 1 Year (Ordinary Year).

So, 1 Ordinary Year has 1 odd day,

then, 6 July 2010 will be Wednesday - 1 = Tuesday.

Now, the number of days between 16 February 2010 to 6 July 2010.

= 12 (Feb) + 31 (March) + 30 (April) + 31 (May) + 30 (June) + 6 (July) = 140 days.

= 140 days → 140/7 = 20 weeks and 0 odd day.

So, **16 February 2010** was Tuesday - 0 = Tuesday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
What will come in the place of '?' in the following equation, if '+' and ‘-' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged?

121 × 11 ÷ 7 - 15 + 23 = ?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2042326d26ec7b593e52bbbdd22d890b59b1e59f92be81a7235509e9af1c4625.png] 

According to the given question:

 
 

 Symbols
 Interchanged with
 
 

 **+**
 **−**
 
 

 -
 **+**
 
 

 ×
 **÷**
 
 

 ÷
 **×**
 
 

 

Given equation : 121 × 11 ÷ 7 - 15 + 23 = ?

Now if '+' and '-' are interchanged with '-' and '+' respectively and '×' and '÷' are interchanged then:

⇒ __**121 **____**÷ 11**__ × 7 + 15 - 23 = ?

⇒ __**11 × 7**__ + 15 - 23 = ?

⇒ __**77**__ + 15 - __**23**__ = ?

⇒ __**92 - 23 **__=** 69**.

Hence, the correct answer is *'Option 1'.*
